data.long_meaning: The name Chandni is derived from the Sanskrit word Chandrika which means 'moon' or 'moonbeam'. In Urdu and Hindi, Chandni is a beautiful name for a girl that evokes images of the tranquil and mesmerizing effect of the moon on the night sky. The name Chandni carries the meaning “Moonlight, Moonbeam” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Chandni usually hope their child will grow to embody moonlight, moonbeam and live with faith, good character and purpose.
